scenes.say: The champion is known, but Valencia still settles three questions. It is the last thousand cc race.
Question one: constructors. Aprilia lead by nine points, and Ducati need at least ten more than them.
Question two: second place among the riders. Martín leads Bezzecchi by two points, both on Aprilia.
Question three: the Moto2 title. It goes down to the last race.
González leads by four and a half points. If Guevara wins, he is champion, even with González second.
A farewell for many: Martín heads to Yamaha, Miller and Binder to WorldSBK. Bagnaia and Viñales miss out.
From twenty twenty-seven MotoGP moves to eight hundred fifty cc. The thousand is history.

title: Valencia: the last 1000cc MotoGP race and three open questions
